Incident reports (unverified): claims include RTH at programmed altitude without issue, loss of all control, and RTH initiated but did not respond. Gaps/conflicts: conflicts between manual RTH behavior and incident claims; unclear causality linking loss of signal to RTH; no explicit, model-agnostic lost-link action list beyond reestablishing link and emergency procedures.
